description: Per-DID mKOTO balance snapshot per ADR-2605282100 L3. Read-side projection of the canonical `balance/mkoto/<DID>` Quad maintained by kotoba-server. Caller-DID self-reads return the current balance; cross-DID reads require operator override or attestation chain match (ADR-2605231525). Non-negative invariant for external callers (ADR-2605282100 N5); SBT-bearer-internal callers may have negative balance up to a Council-set credit_line_mkoto at R2+.

subjectDid.description: DID whose balance this snapshot reflects.

balanceMkoto.description: mKOTO balance saturated to i64 (kotoba native). MUST be >= 0 for external callers (lacking SBT).

lastUpdatedSeq.description: kotoba-kse Journal seq of the latest balance-mutating event (debit / credit / stake-reclaim / royalty-credit). Caller can reconcile against this seq to detect stale snapshots.

observedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the snapshot was computed by kotoba-server.

tariffVersionInForce.description: Tariff version active at snapshot time. Lets the caller display 'balance covers ~N calls at current rates' UI.

sbtBearer.description: True iff subjectDid holds a religious-corp Adherent SBT per ADR-2605172600. Determines whether negative-balance carve-out is permitted (R2+).
